title: vv-harness features.json
description: Canonical definition of the .harness/features.json envelope and the feature object it contains. This is the single authoritative source for the field list; rules/parallel-work.md and skills/harness-init/SKILL.md link here instead of restating it. scripts/validate-features.py implements these checks by hand (stdlib only, no jsonschema dependency) so this file documents intent for humans and external tools rather than being loaded at validation time. This file also hosts $defs/harness_worker_block (F016/OVI-57), an independent schema for .harness/harness.json's optional worker block -- not part of the features.json envelope above, just co-located here since this is the plugin's one canonical schema location. .harness/harness.json also has an optional plugin_version field (F068, a bare string recording the plugin version the project was last synced against, written by scripts/stamp.sh and refreshed by harness-doctor --fix) -- no $defs entry here since it is a single scalar, not a nested object needing field-level validation like the worker block.

project.description: Project name, set once at /harness-init time.

created.description: ISO date the harness was initialized for this project.

total_features.description: Count of entries in features[]. Kept in sync by whoever adds or removes a feature.

passing.description: Count of features with status "passing". Kept in sync alongside total_features.

features.description: The tracked feature list. Each entry is a feature object (see $defs/feature).

id.description: Unique feature id, e.g. F001. Lead assigns at feature-creation time; never reused.

description.description: What the feature is. Once a spec object is attached, editing this string invalidates spec.hash.

priority.description: Lower numbers claim first. Lead sets at creation time.

status.description: Exhaustive enum. See the Feature Schema section of rules/parallel-work.md for the meaning of each value.

scope.description: Directories and files this feature owns. Used in spawn prompts to define teammate boundaries.

depends_on.description: Feature ids that must reach status "passing" before this one may start.

assigned_to.description: Teammate name when Agent Teams is active, or "single-session"; null otherwise.

test_file.description: Path to the test file proving this feature. Required non-null once status is "passing".

coverage.description: Coverage percentage on touched code, or a descriptive string for projects without coverage tooling (e.g. "n/a (shell suite, no coverage tooling; full_test is the gate)"). Required non-null once status is "passing".

notes.description: Free-form context: Linear issue id, decisions, anything not captured by other fields.

correction_cycles.description: Operational metric, optional for backward compatibility with pre-v3.3 features.json files. Incremented automatically by verify-task-quality.sh on each TaskCompleted rejection. Never manually set.

scope_expansions.description: Operational metric, optional for backward compatibility. Files/directories added to scope after initial assignment.

approaches_tried.description: Operational metric, optional for backward compatibility. Brief notes on approaches attempted before the passing implementation.

failure_reason.description: Operational metric, optional for backward compatibility. Why the feature reached status "failed".

discovered_via.description: Operational metric, optional for backward compatibility. Id of the feature whose implementation revealed the need for this one.

spec.description: Optional spec-verification record; absent or null means unverified. See schemas/readiness-stamp.md for the canonical hashing recipe.

hash.description: sha256 of the description string exactly as stored.

qa_binding.description: Optional, for backward compatibility. Declared at prep time (harness-issue-prep Step 5's mandatory 'QA binding' line): the evidence_type this feature promises to be proven with. verify-task-quality.sh compares it against proof.evidence_type to warn on a mismatch. Absent/null for legacy features.

proof.description: Optional, for backward compatibility. Claim-matched evidence recorded at completion time. Absent or null means no proof recorded. When present, all four subfields are required and must be non-empty.

evidence_type.description: What kind of evidence this is; compared against qa_binding.

artifact.description: Path or URL: test file, screenshot dir, recording, CI run.

not_established.description: HE's honesty field: what the evidence did NOT establish. Explicit content required (e.g. "none" is valid, but the key must be present and non-empty).

coverage_target.description: Optional, for backward compatibility. Overrides the 95% default coverage gate; integer 1-100. Overrides should be justified in notes -- advisory only, never machine-enforced.

delivered.description: Optional, for backward compatibility. Delivery closure for projects that ship via PRs. Absent or null means not yet delivered or not applicable.

merged_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp; the validator rejects a malformed value.

design_contract.description: Optional, for backward compatibility. Pointer to a locked design artifact (mock, redline, screenshot set) that journey or manual proof is compared against.

risk.description: Optional, for backward compatibility (F064). Set by harness-issue-prep Step 7 when a readiness stamp is minted, mirroring the lane/risk question it already asks; the lead may also set it directly at Phase 1 team-design time for locally-scoped features with no stamp. Absent/null means unassessed. This is the durable local source harness-continue Phase 4 step 3.5 reads to decide whether to gate the conformance-tester spawn on 'elevated' -- previously that decision depended on a transient Linear stamp comment or the lead's own memory, neither of which survives compaction.

require_plan_approval.description: Optional, for backward compatibility (F064). Whether this feature requires an explicit plan-approval step before an implementer proceeds (Agent Teams Phase 1). Absent/null means unassessed -- see harness-continue step 3.5's legacy fallback; do not infer false. Set alongside risk, same sources and same durability rationale.

harness_worker_block.description: The optional worker block in .harness/harness.json (F016/OVI-57) -- NOT part of the features.json envelope above; a separate, independent schema hosted in this file since it is the plugin's one canonical schema location. Written by /harness-init and refreshed by harness-continue's Step 2.6 epoch check. Absence is valid: an old project, or one that has never run the epoch check, has no worker key at all in harness.json.

cli_version.description: The Claude Code CLI version this epoch's metrics were recorded under, e.g. "2.1.4". Compared against `claude --version`'s live output by Step 2.6; a minor-version delta >= 10 triggers a requalification prompt.

models.description: Current model bindings, one per role. This is DATA (what is actually configured right now) -- the model-selection POLICY (which role gets which tier, and why) stays in agent frontmatter and rules/parallel-work.md's Model Selection table; this block never duplicates or overrides that policy.

recorded_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this worker block was last written or refreshed.
